resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

practice_tasks: Initialize a local Git repository, make commits, push to GitHub, and practice resolving a simple merge conflict.
Solve 5 easy array/string problems on LeetCode focusing on systematically debugging syntax and logic errors.
Complete lessons 1 through 6 on SQLBolt covering basic queries and filtering.
Solve 5 intermediate-level array or hashing problems on LeetCode while practicing step-by-step rubber-duck debugging.
Write SQL queries involving JOINs, GROUP BY, and aggregations using a local or online PostgreSQL playground.
Use Postman to make GET and POST requests to a public API (like JSONPlaceholder) and inspect HTTP response status codes and headers.
Write a basic unit test for a simple function using a language-native testing framework (e.g., Jest or PyTest).
Write a Dockerfile for a simple script or API, build the image, and run it locally in a container.
Review core Agile/Scrum ceremonies and draft a mock backlog with user stories for a personal project.
